item.title: Main opposition party adopts preferential voting for leadership election...Pro-Lee faction's Lee Seong-yun resigns from Supreme Council, says "unacceptable" (與 당대표 선거 ‘선호투표제’로...친청 이성윤, 최고위원 사퇴 “용납 못해”)
item.description:
Main opposition party adopts preferential voting for leadership election...Pro-Lee faction's Lee Seong-yun resigns from Supreme Council, says "unacceptable" (與 당대표 선거 ‘선호투표제’로...친청 이성윤, 최고위원 사퇴 “용납 못해”)

The Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) revised its internal rules on the 14th to introduce a preferential voting system in the election for party leader. While the conflict within the leadership over the rules for the August 17 national convention was temporarily resolved in favor of implementing preferential voting, aftershocks continue as Lee Seong-yun, a Supreme Council member classified under the pro-Lee Jae-myung faction, resigned from the Supreme Council in protest. <<> The DPK's senior spokesperson, Kang Jun-hyun, met with reporters after the closed-door Supreme Council meeting and stated, "Ahead of the third regular national party member convention, we aimed to revise the rules to minimize controversy over regulations regarding the election of the leadership," adding, "A revision to the party rules, specifying that preferential voting and runoff voting can be conducted as methods for implementing a runoff election, was approved." <<> Earlier, the DPK's National Convention Preparatory Committee had decided to apply the preferential voting system to the party leadership election at the August 17 convention. The preferential voting system works by excluding the lowest-ranking candidate if no one secures a majority, then adding the second-choice votes from ballots cast for that excluded candidate to the remaining candidates. Following the committee's decision, the Supreme Council saw ongoing disagreements over whether this violated the party's constitution and rules. The DPK leadership had set a goal of resolving the convention rule issue at the Supreme Council level before candidate registration. <<> After leaving the meeting midway, Council member Lee met with reporters and said, "With only a month left until the national convention and just a week until candidate registration, I have raised objections and opposed forcing through something that violates the party constitution and rules." He continued, "Despite countless objections, the same content was brought up, and I absolutely cannot accept it," adding, "I cannot even participate in today's vote." He stated, "I believe it is no longer possible for me to carry out my duties as a Supreme Council member in this state, so I am resigning from the position effective today," and emphasized, "I am prepared to do whatever it takes to protect our party and its members." <<> Other opposing Supreme Council members, while maintaining their stance against the introduction of preferential voting, indicated they would accept it to prevent a party breakdown. Council member Park Gyu-hwan told reporters, "I cannot understand why there is a persistent push for a specific voting method even at the cost of violating the party constitution and rules," adding, "It is also hard to accept the reality where even the basic principle of following majority rule when unanimous agreement isn't reached is disregarded, forcing a minority decision on us." <<> However, Council member Park added, "Because we cannot stop the Democratic Party—the ruling party bearing infinite responsibility for state affairs, running for the people and for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration—I had no choice but to make a decision." He said, "I feel like I understand the heart of the real mother in Solomon's judgment," and added, "Since the party must exist for there to be a party constitution, I reluctantly accepted this cup, focusing only on the Democratic Party." <<> Senior spokesperson Kang explained that the party rule revision was approved through oral consent without a vote. He said, "Each member did speak, and it's true there were disputes," adding, "With about a month left until the convention, they expressed acceptance for the sake of the party and the people, so it was approved by oral consent without a vote." Regarding Council member Lee, he explained, "He briefly stated that the rule revision was a matter of amending the party constitution and then left," adding, "Since we had a quorum for the vote, we excused him and proceeded." <<> During the Supreme Council meeting that day, the method for selecting a youth Supreme Council member was also discussed but voted down. The leadership debated a plan to separately elect one of the five elected Supreme Council members as a youth representative, but it failed to pass in the vote. Senior spokesperson Kang stated, "Since the agenda item on the youth Supreme Council member was rejected, it seems it will be referred back to the convention committee for re-discussion," adding, "There is no issue with the candidate registration schedule at all." <<> Following this, pro-Lee Jae-myung lawmakers also met with reporters. Supreme Council member Hwang Myeong-seon said, "The convention committee's decision to introduce a youth Supreme Council system was rejected. I am outraged." He then asked, "Is it the duty of a Supreme Council member to criticize the party constitution and rules, obstruct progress for a week, divide party members, and cause public concern?" <<> Supreme Council member Kang Deuk-gu remarked, "Former leader Jeong Cheong-rae said (about the youth Supreme Council system) that it 'has potential for controversy,'" and asked, "If they truly thought there was a real problem, why didn't they confidently bring the agenda to the party affairs committee?" Council member Kang also said, "Former leader Jeong Cheong-rae's one-year term as party leader disguised itself as a 'one-person-one-vote' system but was thoroughly centered on leader Jeong Cheong-rae," adding, "The example of that is seen in the Supreme Council members who are with former leader Jeong. The people and party members will judge at the national convention." <<> Amid this, party leadership contenders including former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, and lawmaker Song Young-gil also began targeting party member sentiment. Former Prime Minister Kim was scheduled to attend a Gyeonggi Provincial Party executive committee meeting and then hold a debate titled '2030 Democratic Party, Youth-Friendly Democratic Party' at the National Assembly. Former leader Jeong was set to appear on several YouTube broadcasts. Lawmaker Song was scheduled to complete radio and YouTube broadcast appearances before meeting with officials from the National Association of Honam People and the Gyeonggi Association of Honam People. (더불어민주당이 14일 당대표 선거에 선호투표제를 도입할 수 있도록 당규를 개정했다. 8·17 전당대회 룰을 둘러싼 지도부 내 갈등은 일단 선호투표제 도입 쪽으로 정리됐지만, 친청계로 분류되는 이성윤 최고위원이 이에 반발해 최고위원직 사퇴를 선언하면서 후폭풍이 이어지고 있다.)

item.title: President Lee to Hold Citizen-Participatory Work Reports Starting Tomorrow (李대통령, 내일부터 국민참여 업무보고)
item.description:
President Lee to Hold Citizen-Participatory Work Reports Starting Tomorrow (李대통령, 내일부터 국민참여 업무보고)

The presidential office announced on the 14th that President Lee Jae-myung will receive work reports from each ministry starting with the Ministry of Economy and Finance on the 15th, held nine times under the theme of 'An Irreplaceable Republic of Korea Experienced in Daily Life.' This marks the second round of work reports since his inauguration. During the first round of reports conducted at the end of last year, it was planned to check whether the contents reported by each ministry were being properly implemented. (이재명 대통령이 15일부터 재정경제부를 시작으로 9차례에 걸쳐 ‘삶으로 체감하는 대체 불가 대한민국’이라는 주제로 각 부처 업무 보고를 받는다고 청와대가 14일 밝혔다. 업무 보고는 취임 후 두 번째다. 지난 연말 진행한 첫 업무 보고 당시 각 부처의 보고 내용이 제대로 이행되고 있는지 점검할 예정이다.)

The total list of reporting agencies includes the Office for Government Policy Coordination, 19 ministries, 6 agencies, 18 offices, and 7 committees, along with 140 public institutions pursuing citizen-experienced livelihood projects. On the first day, the 15th, starting at 10 AM, the Ministry of Economy and Finance (including the National Tax Service, Korea Customs Service, and Public Procurement Service), the National Data Agency, the Financial Services Commission, and the Ministry of Strategy and Finance will conduct reports for about 100 minutes. (전체 보고 대상 기관은 국무조정실과 19부 6처 18청 7위원회를 포함해 국민 체감형 민생 사업을 추진하는 140개 공공기관이다. 이 중 첫날인 15일에는 오전 10시부터 재정경제부(국세청·관세청·조달청), 국가데이터처, 금융위원회, 기획예산처가 약 100분간 보고를 진행한다.)

On the following day, the 16th, in the morning, work reports will be held by the Ministry of Science and ICT (including the Korea AeroSpace Administration), the Broadcasting and Media Communication Commission, and the Personal Information Protection Commission. At 2 PM on the same day, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (including the Administrative City Construction Agency and the Saemangeum Development Agency), the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs (including the Rural Development Administration and the Korea Forest Service), and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries (including the Korea Coast Guard) will report. Starting at 4:20 PM, the Ministry of Health and Welfare (including the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency), the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family, and the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission will take turns reporting. Work reports for other ministries are scheduled to take place in early August. (이튿날인 16일 오전에는 과학기술정보통신부(우주항공청)·방송미디어통신위원회·개인정보보호위원회의 업무 보고가 이뤄진다. 같은 날 오후 2시에는 국토교통부(행정중심복합도시건설청·새만금개발청)·농림축산식품부(농촌진흥청·산림청)·해양수산부(해양경찰청)가, 오후 4시 20분부터는 보건복지부(질병관리청)·식품의약품안전처·성평등가족부·국민권익위원회가 차례로 업무보고에 나선다. 그 외 부처의 업무보고는 8월 초에 진행될 예정이다.)

For this round of work reports, about 20 citizens per session, totaling around 200 people, will attend as a citizen participation group. The presidential office previously recruited applicants via social media, and the competition ratio was approximately 6.3 to 1, according to the office's explanation. (이번 업무 보고에는 매회 약 20여 명씩 모두 200여 명의 국민참여단이 현장을 찾는다. 앞서 청와대는 SNS를 통해 신청자를 모집했고 경쟁률은 약 6.3대 1이었다고 청와대는 설명했다.)

item.title: Chung Pointsung: "People Power Party Threatens to Monopolize Committees... If That's What They Want, Amend the National Assembly Act and Take Them" (정점식 “與, 상임위 독식 협박...원하면 국회법 개정해 가져가라”)
item.description:
Chung Pointsung: "People Power Party Threatens to Monopolize Committees... If That's What They Want, Amend the National Assembly Act and Take Them" (정점식 “與, 상임위 독식 협박...원하면 국회법 개정해 가져가라”)

As the People Power Party boycotts amid the Democratic Party of Korea's unilateral committee formation, People Power Party floor leader Chung Pointsung said on the 14th, "If they can only be satisfied by taking all 18 standing committees, then let them take them all." (국민의힘이 더불어민주당의 일방적 상임위 구성에 반발하며 보이콧을 하고 있는 가운데 국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 14일 “18개 상임위를 다 가져가야만 직성이 풀린다면 다 가져가라”고 했다.)

Floor leader Chung stated at a floor strategy meeting held at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, that morning, "Instead, go ahead and unilaterally amend the National Assembly Act so that the largest party in the chamber monopolizes the chairmanship of all 18 standing committees and take them." (정 원내대표는 이날 오전 서울 여의도 국회에서 열린 원내대책회의에서 “대신 아예 원내 제1당이 18개 상임위원장직을 독식한다고 국회법을 단독 개정하고 가져가라”고 했다.)

He criticized the Democratic Party, saying, "The Democratic Party is repeatedly using threatening media tactics to claim they will take all 18 standing committees," and added, "Stop deceiving the public by pretending negotiations between the ruling and opposition parties exist through threats that are not negotiations or pointless stalling." (그는 민주당을 향해 “민주당이 18개 상임위를 모두 가져가겠다는 협박성 언론 플레이를 반복하고 있다”며 “더 이상 협상 아닌 협박 또는 무의미한 시간 끌기로 여야 간의 협상이 존재하는 것처럼 국민을 속이지 말라”고 했다.)

The People Power Party's boycott of standing committees has now entered its second week. Floor leader Chung held a meeting of senior lawmakers and a general meeting of party lawmakers the previous day to gather their opinions. It was reported that at these meetings, People Power Party lawmakers reached a consensus to maintain the policy of a full boycott of National Assembly standing committees. (국민의힘의 상임위 보이콧은 2주째 계속되고 있다. 정 원내대표는 전날 중진 간담회와 의원총회를 연달아 열고 의원들의 의견을 들었다. 이 자리에서 국민의힘 의원들은 국회 상임위 전면 보이콧 방침을 유지하는 데 공감대를 이룬 것으로 전해졌다.)

Floor leader Chung met with reporters after a meeting with 12 senior lawmakers the previous morning and said, "The general sentiment is whether it even makes sense to enter into negotiations over the formation of committees under the current circumstances," and added, "I think the views of the senior lawmakers and other lawmakers are likely to be largely aligned." (정 원내대표는 전날 오전 중진 의원 12명과 간담회 이후 기자들과 만나 “대체적 생각은 원 구성 협상도 지금 같은 상황에 들어가는 게 맞냐는 것”이라며 “중진들 생각과 다른 의원들 생각이 거의 일치하지 않을까 생각은 든다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Whistleblowers of Corruption to Receive 30% of Reported Amount as Reward (부정부패 신고자에게 신고액 30% 보상금으로 준다)
item.description:
Whistleblowers of Corruption to Receive 30% of Reported Amount as Reward (부정부패 신고자에게 신고액 30% 보상금으로 준다)

The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission is pushing for a plan to give whistleblowers 30% of the amount recovered when the state recovers revenue that was nearly lost due to corruption, through reports from citizens. It also seeks to abolish the reward cap, which was previously limited to 3 billion won. (국가가 부정부패로 잃어버릴 뻔한 수익을 국민의 신고로 회복하게 된 경우, 신고자에게 그 금액의 30%를 보상금으로 주는 방안을 국민권익위원회가 추진한다. 30억원으로 제한됐던 보상금 상한의 폐지도 추진된다.)

On the 14th, the Commission announced that it would pre-announce legislation for amendments to the enforcement decrees of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission Act, the Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Act, and the Public Finance Recovery Act, containing these provisions, from that day until the 24th of next month. During this period, the Commission will gather opinions from relevant ministries. General citizens can also submit their opinions through the National Participation Legislative Center (opinion.lawmaking.go.kr) and other channels. Once the amendments reflecting each opinion pass through a vice-ministerial meeting and are approved by the Cabinet, the enforcement decrees will be formally revised. (권익위는 14일 이러한 내용을 담은 부패방지권익위법 시행령과 공익신고자 보호법 시행령, 공공재정환수법 시행령 개정안을 이날부터 다음 달 24일까지 입법 예고한다고 밝혔다. 이 기간 동안 권익위는 개정안에 관해 관계 부처에서 의견을 수렴한다. 일반 국민도 국민참여입법센터(opinion.lawmaking.go.kr) 등을 통해 의견을 낼 수 있다. 각 의견을 반영한 개정안이 차관회의를 거쳐 국무회의를 통과하면 시행령들이 실제로 개정된다.)

Currently, there is a differential reward rate depending on the amount of revenue the state has recovered. If the recovered amount is 1 billion won or less, 30% is given as a reward. However, for portions between 1 billion and 5 billion won, it is 20%; between 5 billion and 20 billion won, 14%; between 20 billion and 40 billion won, 8%; and for amounts exceeding 40 billion won, only 4% is given. This creates a structure where the reward rate decreases as the contribution of the corruption whistleblower increases. (현재는 국가가 수입을 회복한 금액이 얼마인지에 따라 보상 비율에 차등이 있다. 수입 회복 금액이 1억원 이하일 때는 30%를 보상금으로 주지만, 1억~5억원 부분에 대해서는 20%, 5억~20억원 부분에 대해서는 14%, 20억~40억원 부분에 대해서는 8%, 40억원을 초과하는 부분에 대해서는 4%만 준다. 부정부패 신고자의 공헌이 클수록 보상 비율이 낮아지는 구조다.)

The Commission decided to eliminate this differentiation and provide 30% as a reward regardless of the amount of revenue recovered. It also decided to abolish the reward cap, which was applied differently depending on the type of report. Currently, there is no cap on rewards for 'public interest reports,' but for 'corruption reports' or reports of violations of the Public Finance Recovery Act, the reward is limited to a maximum of 3 billion won. The plan is to remove this distinction. (권익위는 이런 차등을 없애고, 수입 회복 금액이 얼마인지와 상관없이 30%를 보상금으로 주기로 했다. 또 신고의 종류에 따라 달리 적용되던 보상금 상한도 폐지하기로 했다. 지금은 ‘공익 신고’를 한 경우에는 보상금에 상한이 없지만, ‘부패 신고’나 공공재정환수법 위반 신고를 한 경우에는 보상금이 최대 30억원으로 제한되는데, 이 구분을 없애겠다는 것이다.)

Consequently, rewards for those who report large-scale corruption cases will increase significantly. For example, someone reporting a 10 billion won corruption case would currently receive only 720 million won as a reward, but if the new enforcement decree passes, they would be able to receive 3 billion won. (이에 따라, 대규모 부정부패 사건을 신고한 사람에 대한 보상금이 크게 늘어난다. 예를 들어, 100억원 규모의 부정부패를 신고한 사람이라면 보상금으로 지금은 7억2000만원만 받아갈 수 있지만, 새 시행령이 통과되면 30억원을 받아갈 수 있게 된다.)

The Commission stated, however, that it will maintain the current deduction criteria for evaluating the whistleblower’s contribution. Rewards will be reduced if the reported content is inaccurate or the credibility of evidence is somewhat low, if the reported information has already been disclosed through the media, if the whistleblower themselves was involved in the illegal act, or if the whistleblower had an initial duty to report. This will remain the same going forward. (권익위는 다만 신고자의 공헌도를 평가하는 감액 기준은 지금처럼 유지하겠다고 했다. 신고 내용이 부정확하거나 증거 자료의 신빙성이 다소 낮은 경우, 신고한 내용이 언론을 통해 이미 공개된 내용인 경우, 신고자 본인도 불법행위에 가담한 경우, 신고자에게 애초에 신고 의무가 있는 경우에는 보상금이 감액되는데, 이는 앞으로도 마찬가지라는 것이다.)

Vice Chairperson Lee Myung-soon of the Anti-Corruption Bureau at the Commission said, “This amendment to the enforcement decree is meaningful in reorganizing the reward system so that citizens who bravely report for the public interest receive compensation commensurate with their contribution,” adding, “We will continue to improve the protection and reward systems so that citizens can report with peace of mind.” (권익위 이명순 부패방지 담당 부위원장은 “이번 시행령 개정은 공익을 위해 용기 있게 신고한 국민이 그 기여에 상응하는 보상을 받을 수 있도록 보상 체계를 정비하는 데 의미가 있다”며 “앞으로도 국민이 안심하고 신고할 수 있도록 보호·보상 제도를 지속적으로 개선해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "We Were Criticized for Boosting Cho Kuk, But Shouldn't Have Run a Candidate in Pyeongtaek B" (정청래 “조국 키운다 공격 받았겠지만, 평택乙 후보 안 냈어야”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae: "We Were Criticized for Boosting Cho Kuk, But Shouldn't Have Run a Candidate in Pyeongtaek B" (정청래 “조국 키운다 공격 받았겠지만, 평택乙 후보 안 냈어야”)

Jung Cheong-rae, a candidate for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 14th regarding the loss in the by-election for Pyeongtaek B, held alongside the June 3 local elections, "Looking back now, I think it would have been right for the Democratic Party not to field a candidate." (더불어민주당 당권 주자인 정청래 전 대표는 14일 지난 6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러진 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거 패배와 관련해 “지금 되돌아보면 민주당이 후보를 내지 않는 게 맞지 않았을까 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Appearing on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube broadcast that day, Jung explained, "At the time, when the Rebuilding Korea Party said the Democratic Party shouldn't run a candidate, we couldn't say, 'We won't field one.' I believed it was the party leader's duty to run candidates in all districts and do our best to win." (정 전 대표는 이날 김어준씨의 유튜브 방송에 출연해 “당시에는 조국혁신당에서 민주당 후보를 내지 말라고 했을 때 ‘안 내겠다’고 할 수는 없었다”며 “전 지역에 후보를 내고 최선을 다해 승리하는 것이 당대표로서 당연한 의무라고 생각했다”고 밝혔다.)

He added, "In the end, it resulted in handing a seat to the People Power Party through a fluke. I also wonder what might have happened if the merger had succeeded before the June 3 local elections." (그는 “결과적으로는 어부지리로 국민의힘에 한 석을 넘겨준 상황이 됐다”며 “6·3 지방선거 전에 합당이 성공했다면 어땠을까 하는 생각도 많이 하게 된다”고 했다.)

In the Pyeongtaek B by-election, former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam, a prosecutor-turned-politician who served in the 19th National Assembly under the Saenuri Party, the predecessor of the People Power Party, was strategically nominated as the Democratic Party candidate. Kim ran as the People Power Party candidate for Suwon mayor in 2022, then left the party in 2024 to join the Reform Party, later entering the Democratic Party during the last presidential election as part of President Lee Jae-myung's move to expand integration and outreach. Rebuilding Korea Party leader Cho Kuk also ran, but the two candidates failed to unify, leading to the election of the People Power Party's Yoo Eui-dong. (평택을 재선거에는 검사 출신으로 국민의힘 전신인 새누리당에서 19대 국회의원을 지낸 김용남 전 의원이 민주당 후보로 전략공천됐다. 김 전 의원은 2022년 국민의힘 수원시장 후보로 출마했고, 2024년 국민의힘을 탈당해 개혁신당에 합류했다가 지난 대선 당시 이재명 대통령의 통합·외연 확장 인사로 민주당에 입당했다. 조국혁신당에서는 조국 대표가 출마했지만 두 후보의 단일화가 무산됐고, 국민의힘 유의동 후보가 당선됐다.)

Jung explained that if the Democratic Party hadn't fielded a candidate then, internal criticism against him would have been fierce. He said, "If we had done that, I would have faced criticism and attacks, like, 'Isn't Jung Cheong-rae, as party leader, trying to boost Cho Kuk?' or 'This is a revival of the pro-Moon faction.' There would have been much confusion and division, but if we had done that, the outcome might have been different." (정 전 대표는 당시 민주당이 후보를 내지 않았다면 자신을 향한 당내 비판도 거셌을 것이라고 설명했다. 그는 “그렇게 했으면 ‘정청래 당대표가 조국을 키워주려고 하는 것 아니냐’, ‘친문 부활이 맞다’는 비난과 공격을 받았을 것”이라며 “많은 혼란과 분열도 있었겠지만, 그렇게 했다면 결과는 달라졌을 것”이라고 말했다.)

He continued, "The pain is that you can't live life twice. At the time, we couldn't make that choice because of such attacks, but looking back now, I think we should have done it." He added, "Regarding the Pyeongtaek B election, I bear significant responsibility as the former party leader." (이어 “세상은 두 번 살지 못하는 것이 아픔”이라며 “당시에는 그런 공격 때문에 선택하지 못했지만, 지금 되돌아보면 그렇게 했어야 했던 것 같다”고 했다. 그러면서 “평택을 선거에 대해서는 당대표였던 제 책임이 크다고 본다”고 말했다.)

Reflecting on his judgment at the time, Jung said, "I think I was gripped by the obsession that the most important duty of a party leader is to field candidates in all districts and win." He remarked, "At the time, I was deep in the intense campaign environment, but I should have looked at the overall situation from a broader perspective." (정 전 대표는 당시 판단에 대해 “모든 지역에 후보를 내고 이기는 것이 당대표의 가장 중요한 책무라는 강박관념이 컸던 것 같다”고 돌아봤다. 그는 “당시에는 치열한 선거 현장 안에 들어가 있었지만, 전체 전황을 좀 더 멀리서 봤어야 했다”고 했다.)

He also acknowledged his responsibility for the failed merger with the Rebuilding Korea Party. Jung stated, "I wanted to propose and push for a merger, but there was strong opposition, and ultimately it failed. Regarding criticisms that the process was abrupt and rough, I admit I fell short, and that's my responsibility." (조국혁신당과의 합당이 무산된 데 대해서도 자신의 책임을 인정했다. 정 전 대표는 “합당을 제안하고 추진하고 싶었지만 강력한 반대가 있었고, 결과적으로 실패했다”며 “과정이 전격적이고 거칠었다는 지적에는 부족함이 있었고, 그 부분은 제 책임”이라고 말했다.)

However, he maintained that the need for integration between the Democratic Party and the Rebuilding Korea Party remains valid. Jung said, "If the goal is to win general and presidential elections and recreate the government, then outside the party, we need to integrate where integration is possible and form alliances where alliances are needed. Whether to merge should be first asked of the members of the Democratic Party and the Rebuilding Korea Party." (다만 그는 민주당과 조국혁신당의 통합 필요성은 여전히 유효하다는 입장을 밝혔다. 정 전 대표는 “총선과 대선 승리, 정권 재창출이 목표라면 당 밖으로는 통합할 곳은 통합하고 연대할 곳은 연대해야 한다”며 “합당 여부는 민주당과 조국혁신당 당원들에게 먼저 물어야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Government Announces Additional $3.5 Million in Humanitarian Aid for Venezuela Earthquake Relief (정부, 베네수엘라 강진 피해에 350만달러 추가 인도적 지원)
item.description:
Government Announces Additional $3.5 Million in Humanitarian Aid for Venezuela Earthquake Relief (정부, 베네수엘라 강진 피해에 350만달러 추가 인도적 지원)

The government announced on the 14th that it has decided to provide $3.5 million (approximately 5.2 billion won) in humanitarian aid, considering the continuously expanding scale of damage from the recent severe earthquake in Venezuela. This is an additional measure following the decision in late June to provide $5 million in humanitarian aid to Venezuela. (정부는 최근 베네수엘라에서 발생한 강진으로 피해 규모가 지속 확대되는 상황을 감안해 350만달러(약 52억원) 상당의 인도적 지원을 제공하기로 결정했다고 14일 밝혔다. 지난 6월 말 베네수엘라에 500만달러 규모의 인도적 지원을 결정한 데 이은 추가 조치다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated, "Of this aid, $3 million will be used through the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) for debris removal activities to help residents quickly return to their daily lives." (외교부는 “이번 지원 중 300만달러는 유엔개발계획(UNDP)을 통해 주민들의 조속한 일상 복귀를 돕기 위한 잔해 제거 활동에 사용될 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

In addition, in response to a request from the Venezuelan government, the government decided to provide in-kind support of 30 tons of temporary shelters (family tents), valued at $500,000, for accommodating displaced victims. (정부는 또 베네수엘라 정부의 요청에 따라 이재민 수용을 위한 30톤 분량(50만달러 상당)의 임시 거처(패밀리 텐트)도 현물 지원하기로 했다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs said, "We will continue to provide humanitarian aid to countries and people affected by natural disasters in the future." (외교부는 “앞으로도 자연재해로 피해를 본 국가와 국민들에 대한 인도적 지원을 계속해 나갈 예정”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha Makes Rare Temporary Return to Korea: “Consulting on Overall South Korea-U.S. Relations” (강경화 대사, 이례적 일시 귀국… “한미관계 전반 업무 협의”)
item.description:
Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha Makes Rare Temporary Return to Korea: “Consulting on Overall South Korea-U.S. Relations” (강경화 대사, 이례적 일시 귀국… “한미관계 전반 업무 협의”)

The South Korean Embassy in Washington, D.C., announced that Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha, under the directive of Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, will temporarily return to Korea from the 15th to the 19th to hold consultations on overall South Korea-U.S. relations, including with relevant ministries. Ambassador Kang, who began her role as the first female ambassador since the establishment of diplomatic ties between South Korea and the U.S. in October last year, has visited Korea once this year for personal reasons. It is considered unusual for the ambassador to the U.S. to return to Korea for work consultations, unless it involves a visit by a key figure such as the U.S. president or the annual conference of overseas mission chiefs hosted by the South Korean president. Although the ambassador to the U.S. is classified as a vice-minister-level political official (Grade 14 foreign service officer), they receive minister-level treatment given the importance of South Korea-U.S. relations. <<> South Korea and the U.S. released a “Fact Sheet” covering diplomatic, security, and trade fields last November, but it took half a year to establish a working group to implement it. A kickoff meeting was held in June this year on the occasion of U.S. Deputy Secretary of State for Political Affairs John H. Sullivan’s visit to Korea, but follow-up schedules have not been set. In particular, the so-called “Coupang incident,” which began with a personal information leak, has escalated into a “discrimination” issue against U.S. companies operating in Korea, raising concerns of unusual strains in bilateral relations. Earlier this month, the House Judiciary Committee (chaired by Republican Representative Jim Jordan) released an interim report suggesting that Korean companies are facing discrimination, followed by the White House stating that the “Lee Jae-myung government is targeting Coupang” and that it “will not tolerate unfair practices.” <<> While the National Intelligence Service and the Presidential Office have rebutted claims that they issued “any instructions or orders” during the process of recovering a laptop containing leaked personal information from China, a senior congressional source familiar with the committee’s investigation told this outlet on the 9th that “if the Korean government dismisses the report as ‘meritless,’ the situation will worsen.” In February this year, Congress issued a subpoena to Harold Rogers, interim head of Coupang’s Korean subsidiary, and obtained thousands of communication records between Coupang and the South Korean government. Not only Congress but also Vice President J.D. Vance, the second-highest-ranking official, along with Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Assistant Secretary of State for East Asian and Pacific Affairs Mike Dessombres, and Deputy Assistant Secretary for Japan, Mongolia, and Korea David Wier, among other frontline officials handling Korean Peninsula affairs, have successively expressed concerns over the Coupang issue. <<> The late Senator Lindsey Graham, a close confidant of President Donald Trump whose sudden death has shocked the political world, also claimed on X (formerly Twitter) shortly before his death that “the left-wing government of South Korea is unfairly targeting U.S. companies” in relation to the Coupang incident. This has led to speculation that Trump’s “direct intervention” may be imminent. A source in Washington, D.C., said regarding the Coupang incident, “Multiple actors have conveyed messages to the ambassador’s office, including a willingness to reconcile and seek an exit, but there is a perception that opinions are not being properly relayed beyond the foreign ministry to the security office and others.” As the Coupang incident continues for over six months, acting as an obstacle in South Korea-U.S. relations, it is known that there are differences of opinion within the presidential office between the policy and security lines regarding a way out. (미국 워싱턴 DC의 주미 한국대사관은 강경화 주미대사가 조현 외교부 장관 지시로 15~19일 일시 귀국해 한미 관계 전반에 대해 유관 부처들을 포함한 업무 협의를 가질 예정이라고 밝혔다. 지난해 10월 한미 수교 이래 첫 여성 대사로 업무를 시작한 강 대사는 올해 한 차례 개인 일정 등으로 한국을 찾은 적이 있다. 주재국 대통령 같은 요인 방문, 우리 대통령이 1년에 한 번 주재하는 재외공관장 회의가 아닌 이상 주미대사가 업무 협의를 위해 귀국하는 것은 이례적인 일로 꼽힌다. 주미대사는 직제상 차관급 정무직 공무원(외무공무원 14등급)이지만 한미 관계의 중요성을 고려해 장관급 예우를 받는다.)

item.title: '1 Million Cases Annually' Seal Change Reporting Now Possible at Any Community Center, Not Just the Registered Address One (‘연 100만건’ 인감 변경 신고, 주소지 아닌 주민센터에서도 가능해진다)
item.description:
'1 Million Cases Annually' Seal Change Reporting Now Possible at Any Community Center, Not Just the Registered Address One (‘연 100만건’ 인감 변경 신고, 주소지 아닌 주민센터에서도 가능해진다)

On the 14th, the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission recommended to the Ministry of the Interior and Safety that "seal change reports," which must be filed when a seal is lost or worn out and unusable, be made possible at any community center, not just the one at the registered address. The Ministry of the Interior and Safety has agreed to establish the relevant laws and systems by the end of 2028. <<> According to the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission, while seal certificates can currently be issued anywhere nationwide, seal change reports can only be made by visiting the community center with jurisdiction over the registered address. This has caused inconvenience for those who have moved but not yet updated their address or those on long-term business trips, as they must travel to their registered address each time they need to report a seal change. There have even been cases where individuals urgently needing to conduct real estate or financial transactions faced delays in seal change reports, leading to contract disruptions. <<> The government processes over 1 million seal change reports annually, and complaints about the inconvenience of the current system, which restricts such reports to the registered address, are mounting. A survey conducted by the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission in February among the general public and local government officials revealed that 77.2% of officials had received inquiries about whether seal change reports could be made at community centers other than the registered address. Meanwhile, 91.0% of the public expressed a desire for seal change reports to be possible anywhere nationwide. <<> The reason seal change reports have until now only been possible at the community center of the registered address is that the seal register, which records the physical seal impression received from the person filing the report, has been managed manually in writing. <<> The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission recommended that the Ministry of the Interior and Safety build a system to electronically register and manage the seal register, and based on this, allow seal change reports to be accepted at all community centers nationwide, regardless of the applicant's address. It also recommended establishing a service to notify applicants via text message on their mobile phones, with their consent, once the seal change report is completed. <<> Accepting the recommendation, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety has decided to amend the Seal Certificate Act and its enforcement decree to establish the legal basis, and to build an electronic system, by the end of 2028. <<> The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission also emphasized the need to promote the use of the "Certificate of Personal Signature" (electronic personal signature certificate), which is legally equivalent to a seal certificate and can replace it. If a citizen prints an electronic personal signature certificate from the government24 website and submits it to an institution requiring it, that institution can verify its authenticity through the "e-Hanaro Civil Service" system and use it in place of a seal certificate. However, it has emerged that many public institutions are unaware of this procedure or lack systems to access e-Hanaro Civil Service, and therefore continue to require only seal certificates. <<> The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission recommended that the Ministry of the Interior and Safety revise relevant manuals, such as the "Manual for Requesting Joint Use of Administrative Information," to encourage public institutions to accept electronic personal signature certificates. <<> Han Sam-seok, Vice Chairperson and Secretary General of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission, stated, "This institutional improvement aims to update the seal management system in line with changes in citizens' living areas and to establish a public verification system based on personal signatures in the field. Going forward, the Commission will continue to analyze various civil complaints to bring about tangible institutional improvements that citizens can feel." (인감도장을 잃어버리거나 인감도장이 닳아서 못 쓰게 된 경우에 해야 하는 ‘인감 변경 신고’를 주소지가 아닌 주민센터에서도 할 수 있게 하라고 국민권익위원회가 행정안전부에 14일 권고했다. 행안부는 2028년 말까지 관련 법령과 시스템을 갖추기로 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "The Year of Leaping Toward 3% Potential Growth Rate, Top 4 in Trade, and $50,000 National Income" (李대통령 “잠재성장률 3%·무역 4강·국민소득 5만불 도약 원년”)
item.description:
President Lee: "The Year of Leaping Toward 3% Potential Growth Rate, Top 4 in Trade, and $50,000 National Income" (李대통령 “잠재성장률 3%·무역 4강·국민소득 5만불 도약 원년”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th, "We must accelerate the major economic transformation in the second half of the year," and urged, "Let us join forces so that this year is remembered as the starting point for leaping toward an irreplaceable Republic of Korea with a 3% potential growth rate, the world's top four trading nations, and a national income of $50,000." (이재명 대통령은 14일 “하반기에는 경제대전환을 가속해해야 한다”며 “올해가 잠재성장률 3%, 세계무역 4강, 국민소득 5만불이라는 대체불가 대한민국으로 도약하는 원년으로 기억되도록 힘을 모아달라”고 밝혔다.)

The President made these remarks during his opening statement at a Cabinet meeting held at the Presidential Office in Yongsan, outlining the government's economic goals for the second half of this year. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 모두발언에서 올해 하반기 정부의 경제 목표를 제시하며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Specifically, regarding the "top four in trade," he explained, "Exports in the first half of this year are showing explosive growth, nearing $500 billion, and while semiconductors are leading the growth, exports of other items have also increased by 16% compared to last year," adding, "Becoming one of the world's top four trading nations is no longer an unattainable goal." (구체적으로 우선 ‘무역 4강’에 대해서는 “올해 상반기 수출이 5000억 달러에 육박하는 폭발적인 증가세를 보이고 있고, 반도체가 성장을 주도하는 가운데 다른 품목의 수출도 전년보다 16% 늘어났다”며 “세계 무역 4강이 진입 불가능한 목표가 아니게 됐다”고 설명했다.)

He continued, "Amid remarkable export performance and increased facility investment, there are forecasts that the real growth rate this year will reach 3%," and said, "We must focus all efforts on stabilizing prices and real estate, which are directly linked to the lives of the people, and gradually raise the potential growth rate to 3% by fostering super-gap and super-innovation growth drivers." (이어 “눈부신 수출 실적과 설비 투자 증가를 바탕으로 올해 실질성장률이 3%에 이를 것이라는 전망도 잇따르고 있다”며 “국민의 삶과 직결된 물가와 부동산 안정에 총력을 기울이고 초격차·초혁신 성장동력 육성으로 잠재성장률 3%까지 단계적으로 높여가야 한다”고 했다.)

Furthermore, he emphasized, "In particular, for the early realization of what can be considered the core—the three mega projects—the central government, local governments, and businesses must work as one," urging, "Please expedite the related procedures as much as possible with the mindset that shortening one day now can save ten days or a hundred days later." (그러면서 “특히 그 핵심이라고 할 수 있는 3대 메가 프로젝트의 조기 현실화를 위해 중앙정부와 지방정부, 기업이 한 몸으로 뛰어야 한다”며 “지금 하루를 단축하면 나중에 열흘, 100일을 벌 수 있다는 자세로 관련 절차를 최대한 빠르게 진행해달라”고 했다.)

The President stated, "We must also put effort into resolving our society's structural issues," and added, "We need to provide young people with multi-layered growth ladders in areas such as jobs, housing, assets, and capacity development, and accelerate innovation in public institutions' finances, regulations, and capabilities while easing labor market disparities." (이 대통령은 “우리 사회의 구조적 문제를 해소하는 데도 힘을 쏟아야 한다”며 “청년들에게 일자리·주거·자산·역량개발 등에 있어 다층적인 성장 사다리를 제공하고, 노동시장 격차 완화와 함께 공공기관 재정·규제·역량에서 혁신도 속도 내야 한다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the approach of the third anniversary of the Osong underpass disaster, President Lee said, "I hear that from this year, North Chungcheong Province will actively hold memorial events. It is truly regrettable that it took three years for this obvious action." He added, "The state must always be thoroughly prepared for all disasters that threaten the lives and safety of the people," and emphasized, "Not even the smallest gap should ever be allowed when it comes to protecting people's lives. When it comes to safety issues, it is better to be excessive than insufficient." (한편 이 대통령은 오송 지하차도 참사 3주기가 하루 앞으로 다가온 것에 대해서는 “올해부터는 충청북도가 적극적으로 추모 행사를 한다고 한다. 이 당연한 일에 3년이라는 시간이 걸린 게 참 안타깝다”고 했다. 이어 “국가는 늘 국민의 생명과 안전을 위협하는 모든 재해에 철저히 대비해야 한다”며 “국민의 생명을 지키는 일에는 어떠한 작은 빈틈도 절대 허용해선 안 된다. 안전 문제에 관해서는 지나친 게 부족한 것보다 낫다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Rights Will Create Monster Police" (장동혁 “보완수사권 폐지 땐 괴물 경찰 탄생”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Rights Will Create Monster Police" (장동혁 “보완수사권 폐지 땐 괴물 경찰 탄생”)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk stated on the 14th regarding the Democratic Party of Korea's push for a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act, which aims to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights, that "as seen in the Jang Yun-gi case, handing over all investigative powers to the police and granting them absolute authority will create a monster police force." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 14일 더불어민주당이 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지를 골자로 하는 형사소송법 개정안을 추진하는 데 대해 “장윤기 사건에서 보듯 모든 수사권을 경찰에 넘겨주고 절대 권력을 부여하면 괴물 경찰이 탄생할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Attending the "Discussion on the Investigation Vacuum Revealed by the Jang Yun-gi Case and the Necessity of Supplementary Investigation Rights" held at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, that morning, Representative Jang said, "This is not a matter of political factions, nor is it a gift that can be lightly given to the hardline support base for a party convention for the sake of one person." He added, "That monster police will ultimately devour the lives and safety of the people." (장 대표는 이날 오전 서울 여의도 국회에서 열린 ‘장윤기 사건이 드러낸 수사 공백과 보완수사권의 필요성 토론회’에 참석해 “이건 정파의 문제도 아니고 어느 한 사람을 위해서 전당대회용으로 강성 지지층을 향해서 쉽게 내줄 수 있는 선물이 아니다”라며 이같이 밝혔다. 그러면서 “그 괴물 경찰은 결국 국민 생명과 안전을 집어삼키게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

"I have consistently voiced the need for prosecution reform, but this current situation is completely different," Jang said. "Looking at the Jang Yun-gi case, it's not only impossible to expect the police to conduct a proper investigation in good faith, but rather, what is needed now is a 'police reform' answer." He emphasized, "When the police wield vast powers, there must absolutely be someone to check and control them." (장 대표는 “저는 평소 검찰 개혁 필요성에 목소리를 내왔던 사람이지만, 지금 이 모습은 전혀 아니다”라며 “장윤기 사건을 보면 경찰에게 선의에 기대서 제대로 수사해 달라고 기대하는 것도 아예 불가능할 뿐 아니라 오히려 지금 필요한 것은 ‘경찰 개혁’이라는 답을 얻게 된다”라고 했다. 그러면서 “경찰이 거대한 권력을 행사함에 있어서 반드시 누군가 견제하고 통제할 필요성이 있다”고 했다.)

Chief of the Policy Committee Jeong Jeom-sik also stated, "The Jang Yun-gi case is an incident where the police, who should uncover the truth, instead turned a blind eye to it, concealed evidence, and betrayed the people." He added, "If even the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights are abolished, the minimum checks to prevent poor police investigations and abuse of investigative powers could be rendered ineffective." He stressed, "Supplementary investigation rights are not a system for the prosecution, but a system to protect the rights of the people and prevent unjust victims from emerging." (정점식 원내대표도 “장윤기 사건은 진실을 밝혀야 할 경찰이 오히려 진실을 외면하고 증거를 은폐하고 국민을 배신한 사건”이라고 했다. 그는 “검찰의 보완수사권마저 폐지된다면 경찰의 부실 수사와 수사권 남용을 막을 최소한의 견제 장치마저 무력화될 수 있다”며 “보완수사권은 검찰을 위한 제도가 아닌, 국민의 권리를 보호하고 억울한 피해자가 발생하는 것을 막기 위한 제도”라고 했다.)

Attending the discussion as participants were the victim of the Busan 'spin kick case' and lawyers Choi Chang-ho, Kim Jae-ryeon, and Kim Se-hee. (이날 토론회에는 부산 ‘돌려차기 사건’ 피해자와 최창호·김재련·김세희 변호사가 토론자로 참석했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil: "Jung Cheong-rae at a stalker level toward President Lee... His non-candidacy declaration was also out of nowhere" (송영길 “정청래, 李 대통령 스토커 수준…대선 불출마도 뜬금없더라”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil: "Jung Cheong-rae at a stalker level toward President Lee... His non-candidacy declaration was also out of nowhere" (송영길 “정청래, 李 대통령 스토커 수준…대선 불출마도 뜬금없더라”)

Song Young-gil, a candidate for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea in the August 17th party convention, has described his rival, former leader Jung Cheong-rae, as "at a stalker level toward President Lee Jae-myung." Song also hit back at Jung's criticism of his own departure from the party and denial of the so-called 'Myung-Cheong conflict,' calling it "self-contradictory." (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당권 주자인 송영길 의원이 경쟁자인 정청래 전 대표를 향해 “이재명 대통령 스토커 수준”이라고 말했다. 송 의원은 정 전 대표가 자신의 탈당 이력을 비판하고 이른바 ‘명청 갈등’을 부인한 데 대해서도 “자기모순”이라고 맞받았다.)

In a radio interview on the 14th, Song responded to Jung's statement from the previous day's candidacy declaration that "there is no Myung-Cheong conflict," saying, "Even if he keeps shouting Lee Jae-myung's name alone, without the other party liking or agreeing, does that make the Myung-Cheong confrontation disappear? That's what you call a stalker. It's almost at that level." (송 의원은 14일 한 라디오 방송에서 정 전 대표가 전날 출마 선언을 통해 “명청 갈등은 없다”는 취지로 말한 데 대해 “상대방이 좋아하지 않고 동의하지 않는데 혼자 이재명을 몇 번 외친다고 명청 대전이 없어지느냐”며 “그걸 스토커라고 한다. 거의 그런 수준”이라고 말했다.)

Song repeatedly raised the issue of the discord between the party and the presidential office during Jung's tenure, stating, "It's rare in constitutional history for a conflict between a president with four years left in office and the ruling party leader to become a major media topic." He criticized Jung's emphasis on a "party-government-presidential office one team" by repeatedly mentioning President Lee's name in his candidacy speech, arguing that Jung should reflect on his actual relationship with the presidential office. (송 의원은 “임기 4년이 남은 대통령과 집권당 대표의 갈등이 언론의 주요 주제가 되는 것은 헌정사에서 보기 어려운 일”이라며 정 전 대표 재임 기간 불거진 당·청 간 불협화음을 거듭 문제 삼았다. 정 전 대표가 출마 선언문에서 이 대통령의 이름을 여러 차례 언급하며 ‘당정청 원팀’을 강조한 데 대해서도 실제 대통령실과의 관계를 돌아봐야 한다는 취지로 비판했다.)

Song also took a sharp stance against Jung's declaration in his candidacy speech that he "will not use the party leader position to run for president." Song deemed it inappropriate to mention not running for president when the current administration still has about four years left, calling it "a strange, out-of-place story." (정 전 대표가 출마 선언에서 “당대표직을 이용해 대선에 출마하지 않겠다”고 밝힌 데 대해서도 날을 세웠다. 송 의원은 현 정부 임기가 4년가량 남은 상황에서 대선 불출마를 언급한 것 자체가 부적절하다며 “엇나가는 뜬금없는 이야기”라고 했다.)

Song pointed to Jung's explanation during last year's party convention, where Jung emphasized the importance of the early days of the Lee Jae-myung administration and chose a one-year term as party leader without authority over nominations. Song criticized Jung for now running in a party leadership election with nomination powers, arguing that it is inconsistent to portray that earlier choice as a sacrifice. (송 의원은 정 전 대표가 지난해 전당대회 당시 이재명 정부 출범 초기의 중요성을 강조하며 공천권이 없는 1년 임기의 당대표를 선택했다고 설명했던 점도 거론했다. 그는 당시 선택을 희생으로 내세웠던 정 전 대표가 다시 총선 공천권을 행사할 수 있는 당대표 선거에 출마한 것은 앞뒤가 맞지 않는다고 비판했다.)

Regarding Jung's emphasis on "party before self," Song claimed it was actually "self before party," prioritizing his own political goals. He argued that during the last presidential election, Jung's activities in the Honam region and the appointment of numerous special party advisors ahead of local elections were closer to building an organization for his own re-election rather than for the party's victory. However, this is Song's assessment, while Jung's side has maintained that these actions were aimed at securing election victories and strengthening the party organization. (정 전 대표가 강조한 ‘선당후사’에 대해서도 송 의원은 사실상 자신의 정치적 목적을 앞세운 ‘선청후당’이었다고 주장했다. 지난 대선 당시 호남 활동과 지방선거를 앞두고 임명한 다수의 당대표 특보가 당의 승리보다 연임을 준비하기 위한 조직 구축에 가까웠다는 것이다. 다만 이는 송 의원의 평가로, 정 전 대표 측은 그동안 당의 선거 승리와 조직 강화를 위한 활동이었다는 입장을 보여왔다.)

In response to Jung's criticism of his departure from the party, Song countered, "It was a departure to protect the Democratic Party." Song brought up the incident during the 2022 presidential election when Jung's so-called "Bongyi Kim Seon-dal" remarks sparked backlash from the Buddhist community, arguing that Jung should have taken more proactive measures to reduce the burden on the party and the presidential candidate. (자신의 탈당 이력을 문제 삼은 데 대해서는 “민주당을 지키기 위한 탈당이었다”고 반박했다. 송 의원은 2022년 대선을 앞두고 정 전 대표의 이른바 ‘봉이 김선달’ 발언으로 불교계 반발이 커졌던 일을 거론하며, 당시 정 전 대표가 당과 대선 후보의 부담을 줄이기 위해 보다 적극적인 조처를 했어야 한다는 취지로 말했다.)

Song has been on the offensive since Jung officially announced his candidacy on the 13th. In a radio interview that day, Song claimed that if the party entered the next general election under Jung's leadership, it would be a "certain defeat," and asserted that some party lawmakers share a sense of crisis that it would be difficult to win a general election with Jung's face. (송 의원은 정 전 대표가 출마를 공식 선언한 13일부터 집중 공세를 펴고 있다. 그는 13일 한 라디오 인터뷰에서 정 전 대표 체제로 차기 총선을 치를 경우 “필패”할 것이라며, 당내 일부 의원들 사이에서도 정 전 대표의 얼굴로는 총선을 치르기 어렵다는 위기의식이 있다고 주장했다.)

In another interview the same day, Song directly attacked Jung's statement about protecting President Lee, saying, "What does he think he is, to protect President Lee Jae-myung? You have to win the general election to protect him. Do you think you can win a general election with Jung Cheong-rae's face?" (같은 날 다른 인터뷰에서는 정 전 대표가 이 대통령을 지키겠다고 밝힌 데 대해 “자기가 뭔 이재명 대통령을 지키느냐. 총선에 이겨야 지킬 텐데 정청래 얼굴로 총선을 이길 것 같으냐”고 직격했다.)

Song also said on the YouTube channel Spix that if Jung leads the Democratic Party, "Even my daughter or son wouldn't vote for it." He described Jung's management of the party as "like a frog in a well," and argued that Jung should take responsibility for the local election results, step back for a while, and bring change to the party. (송 의원은 또 유튜브 채널 스픽스에서 정 전 대표 체제로 민주당을 이끌 경우 “우리 딸, 아들도 안 찍을 것”이라고 했다. 정 전 대표의 당 운영을 두고는 “우물 안 개구리 같았다”며, 지방선거 결과에 책임을 지고 한 차례 쉬면서 당에 변화를 줘야 한다고 주장했다.)

The competition among party leadership candidates is also intertwined with the supreme council member election. Observers inside and outside the party note that candidates like Kim Young-ho and Park Sun-won, who are running for the supreme council, are classified as being close to Song, raising the possibility that they could effectively serve as running mates. <<>> (당대표 후보 간 경쟁은 최고위원 선거와도 맞물리는 양상이다. 당 안팎에서는 최고위원 선거에 출마한 김영호·박선원 의원 등이 송 의원과 가까운 후보군으로 분류되며 사실상 러닝메이트 역할을 할 가능성이 거론된다.)

item.title: Lee: "The age for juvenile offenders should be lowered, but by one year seems insufficient..." (李, 촉법소년 연령 “낮추긴 낮춰야, 한살은 부족한것 같기도...”)
item.description:
Lee: "The age for juvenile offenders should be lowered, but by one year seems insufficient..." (李, 촉법소년 연령 “낮추긴 낮춰야, 한살은 부족한것 같기도...”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th regarding the age of "juvenile offenders" who are exempt from criminal punishment, "It seems we do need to lower it." He suggested that the current age range of 10 to under 14 years old for juvenile offenders should be adjusted to lower the upper limit from 14 to 13 years old. (이재명 대통령은 14일 형사처벌을 받지 않는 ‘촉법소년’ 연령에 대해 “낮추긴 낮춰야 할 것 같다”고 말했다. 현재 만 10세 이상~14세 미만인 촉법소년 연령에서 14세를 13세 이하로 낮추는 게 필요하다는 것이다.)

President Lee received a report on the "results of public deliberation on the age standard for juvenile offenders" from the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family during a Cabinet meeting held at the presidential office that day. The Ministry reported that the conclusion of the public deliberation was to lower the age from "under 14 years old" to "under 13 years old" but only for serious, major, or repeat offenses. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 국무회의에서 성평등가족부로부터 ‘촉법소년 연령 기준 공론화 결과’를 보고받았다. 성평등가족부는 강력·중대·반복 범죄에 한해 ‘만 14세 미만’을 ‘만 13세 미만’으로 낮추는 안을 공론화 결론으로 보고했다.)

President Lee, assuming that a certain level of consensus exists on lowering the age for juvenile offenders, stated, "The Ministry of Gender Equality and Family's opinion suggests not lowering it uniformly but only partially lowering it by one year for specific crimes—doesn't that seem too insufficient? Aren't there quite a few countries worldwide that set it at 12 years old?" (이 대통령은 촉법소년 연령을 낮추는 방향에 대한 공감대는 어느 정도 형성되어 있다는 것을 전제로 “성평등가족부 의견은 일률적으로 낮추지 말고 특정 범죄에 대해서만 부분적으로 한 살 낮추자는 말인데 너무 미약하지 않나”라며 “전 세계적으로 12세로 하는 경우도 꽤 많지 않느냐”라고 했다.)

President Lee added, "The issue is how many years to uniformly lower it. Lowering it uniformly by two or three years seems too excessive." However, he continued, "But what about serious crimes? For instance, can't a 12-year-old commit murder or a serious crime? A 12-year-old might exploit that." He also remarked, "I've seen in the media some sensational, extremely exceptional cases where offenders say, 'I won't get punished,' while committing crimes. Seeing that, doesn't it seem that lowering it by just one year is insufficient?" (이 대통령은 “문제는 일률적으로 몇 살까지 낮출 것이냐, 일률적으로 두세 살씩 낮추는 것은 너무 과한 것 같긴 하다”고 했다. 그러면서도 “중대 범죄에 대해서는 어떻게 할 것이냐”며 “예를 들어 열두 살인데 무슨 살인이나 중범죄를 저지를 수 있지 않나, 열두 살이 (그걸 알고) 이용할 수도 있겠고”라고 했다. 이 대통령은 “언론에서 약간 선정적으로 극히 예외적인 경우로 ‘나 처벌 안 받아’ 하면서 (범죄를) 저지르는 장면도 있더라”며 “그런 걸 보면 한 살 만으로 부족하지 않나”라고 했다.)

No final conclusion was reached at the Cabinet meeting that day. President Lee stated, "If we lower it, it seems the maximum would be two years. Let's not make a final decision today. Let's have another discussion within this range next time. Let's also gather more public opinions and conduct a survey." (이날 국무회의에서는 최종 결론은 나지 않았다. 이 대통령은 “낮춘다면 최대가 2년인 것 같다”며 “오늘 최종 결정은 하지 말고, 이 범위 내에서 다음에 한번 또 토론을 한번 하자. 국민 의견 수렴을 또 해보고 여론조사도 해보자”고 했다.)

During the meeting, President Lee also joked about the claims that circulated during past presidential elections that "Lee Jae-myung had been to a juvenile detention center as a child" in relation to the disposition of juvenile offenders. While juvenile offenders are not subject to criminal punishment, they do receive "protective dispositions," which can include being sent to a juvenile detention center. However, such records are not retained, so they do not affect later entry into public office. (이날 회의에선 이 대통령은 촉법소년이 받는 소년원 처분과 관련해 과거 대선 때 돌았던 ‘이재명이 어린 시절 소년원에 다녀왔다’는 주장에 대한 농담을 하기도 했다. 촉법소년의 경우, 형사처벌은 받지 않지만 소년원에 보내지는 ‘보호 처분’은 받는다. 하지만 기록이 남지 않아 이후 공직 진출 등에 영향을 받지는 않는다.)

Upon hearing that the records are not retained, President Lee laughed and said, "So that's why the story about 'Lee Jae-myung's juvenile detention center' came up—because the records are said to have disappeared." During the 2022 and last year's presidential elections, some YouTubers claimed that President Lee had committed crimes as a child and had been to a juvenile detention center. Some of them were investigated for spreading false information. (이 대통령은 기록이 남지 않는다는 관련 내용을 보고받자 “그래서 ‘이재명 소년원’ 이야기가 나온 것이군요, 기록이 없어졌다고”라고 웃으며 말했다. 지난해와 2022년 대선 때 일부 유튜버는 이 대통령이 어린 시절 범죄를 저질러 소년원에 다녀왔다는 취지의 주장을 했고, 이 중 일부는 허위 사실을 유포한 혐의로 수사를 받았다.)

item.title: “I’m Grateful for 30 Million Won, but Would 50 Million Won Be Okay?” Public Official Who Took Bribes Caught by the Board of Audit and Inspection (“3000만원 고마운데, 5000만원 정도까지 괜찮을까” 뇌물 받은 공직자 감사원에 적발)
item.description:
“I’m Grateful for 30 Million Won, but Would 50 Million Won Be Okay?” Public Official Who Took Bribes Caught by the Board of Audit and Inspection (“3000만원 고마운데, 5000만원 정도까지 괜찮을까” 뇌물 받은 공직자 감사원에 적발)

An executive at a public institution was caught by the Board of Audit and Inspection for receiving a bribe of 50 million won in exchange for awarding institutional contracts to a private company. (공공기관 간부가 민간 업체에 기관 일감을 주는 대가로 5000만원 뇌물을 받았다가 감사원에 적발됐다.)

According to the audit report on ‘Public Discipline Inspection’ published by the Board of Audit and Inspection on the 14th, Senior Researcher A at the Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology was put in charge of overseeing a project in 2022 where the South Korean government, as part of Official Development Assistance (ODA), established a smart city construction technology cooperation center in Vietnam. (감사원이 14일 공개한 ‘공직 기강 점검’ 감사 보고서에 따르면, 한국건설기술연구원의 A 선임위원은 2022년 한국 정부가 공적 개발 원조(ODA)의 일환으로 베트남에 스마트 시티 건설 기술 협력 센터를 세워주는 사업을 총괄하게 됐다.)

While on a business trip to Vietnam in April 2022, A met with B, the local head of a private company he had gotten to know during a prior assignment in Vietnam. A demanded 30 million won, promising to help the company win the project. After receiving the company’s introduction document from B via a mobile messenger, A said, “It seems like we’ll have a lot to work on together.” (2022년 4월 베트남으로 출장을 간 A는 앞서 베트남 파견 근무 중 알게 된 한 민간 업체 현지 법인장 B와 만나 ‘업체가 사업을 수주할 수 있게 도와주겠다’며 3000만원을 요구했다. A는 B에게서 모바일 메신저로 업체 소개서를 전달받고는 “같이 할 일이 많을 듯하다”고 말하기도 했다.)

Before the tender notice was even issued for a portion of this project worth 1.94 billion won, A handed over undisclosed internal documents, including design specifications, to B on 19 separate occasions. After B’s company won the project in 2022, A sent B a message via KakaoTalk on October 4, 2022, claiming he had a large loan (700 million won) and demanded an additional 20 million won on top of the originally agreed 30 million won, totaling 50 million won. According to messages secured by the Board of Audit and Inspection, A said, “B, I’m a bit hesitant to say this, but I’m really grateful you’re giving me 3 million—just wondering if 5 million would be okay? I’ll keep it a secret until the day I die.” B responded, “Without you, this (winning the project) wouldn’t have been possible,” and agreed to the demand. (A는 이 사업의 일부분인 19억4000만원짜리 사업과 관련해 입찰 공고를 내기도 전에 B에게 설계 내역서 등 미공개 내부 자료를 19차례에 걸쳐 넘겨줬다. 이후 2022년 B의 업체가 사업을 수주하자, 2022년 10월 4일 B에게 카카오톡으로 메시지를 보내 자기가 받은 대출금(7억원)이 많다면서 기존에 약속한 3000만원에 2000만원을 더해 5000만원을 달라고 요구했다. 감사원이 확보한 메시지에 따르면, A는 “B야 이런 말 하기 조심스럽다만, 3천도 챙겨준다니 참 고마운데, 5천 정도까지 괜찮겠나 모든 건 죽을 때까지 비밀로 하고”라고 했다. B는 “너 아니면 이거(수주) 할 수도 없는 거”였다며 요구를 받아들였다.)

On October 18, 2022, via Telegram, A instructed B to send 50 million won to the account of C, a Vietnamese businessman known to A. The next day, after B sent 50 million won to C’s account, on October 21, A had C transfer 1 billion Vietnamese dong (about 50 million won) to the account of D, another Vietnamese businessman known to A. (A는 2022년 10월 18일 텔레그램을 통해 B에게 5000만원을 자기가 아는 베트남 사업가인 C의 계좌로 보내라고 했다. 이튿날 B가 C 계좌로 5000만원을 보내자, A는 10월 21일 C에게 자기가 아는 다른 베트남 사업가 D의 계좌로 10억동(약 5000만원)을 보내게 했다.)

The Board of Audit and Inspection could not confirm whether the money ultimately reached A because they were unable to investigate the Vietnamese bank accounts. However, based on the messages and phone call records exchanged between A and B, they determined that A had received 50 million won. (감사원은 이 돈이 최종적으로 A에게 갔는지는 베트남 은행 계좌를 조사할 수 없어 확인하지 못했으나, A와 B가 주고받은 메시지와 통화 내용 등을 바탕으로 A가 5000만원을 받았다고 판단했다.)

It was also revealed that A had received airfare and accommodation costs from other private company contacts to whom he had awarded institutional contracts. In September 2022, while traveling to Vietnam for a vacation, A prearranged with the head of a private company to provide airfare and accommodation, receiving round-trip tickets between Incheon and Hanoi worth 650,000 won. To another executive at a different company, A sent a KakaoTalk message saying, “Things like hotel reservations should be handled by the travel team,” while demanding hotel booking and payment. He had them pay 1.28 million won for 13 nights of hotel stay from October 3 to 15 of that year. The Board of Audit and Inspection found that A received a total of 2.53 million won in costs from three trips to Vietnam for vacations or business between September 2022 and March 2023. (A는 자기 기관 일감을 준 다른 민간 업체 관계자들에게서 항공료, 숙박비 등을 받은 것으로도 드러났다. A는 2022년 9월 휴가 목적으로 베트남으로 가면서 민간 업체 대표에게서 항공권과 숙박비를 제공받기로 미리 약속하고, 인천과 하노이 간 왕복 항공권 65만원을 받았다. 또 다른 업체 임원에게는 카카오톡으로 “호텔 예약하고 이런 거는 출장단이 하는 게 맞아요”라는 메시지를 보내면서 호텔 예약과 결제를 요구했고, 그해 10월 3일부터 15일까지 13일간 호텔에 묵은 비용 128만원을 대신 결제하게 했다. 감사원은 이런 식으로 A가 2022년 9월부터 이듬해 3월까지 세 차례 베트남으로 휴가나 출장을 다녀오면서 나온 비용 253만원을 받은 것으로 파악했다.)

A also received round-trip airfare worth 1.06 million won to Ho Chi Minh City in December 2024 from another Vietnamese company representative he had known since 2018. (A는 2018년부터 알고 지내던 다른 베트남 법인 대표에게 2024년 12월 106만원어치 호찌민 왕복 항공권을 제공받기도 했다.)

The Board of Audit and Inspection referred A to the prosecution on charges of bribery and violating the Anti-Corruption Act, and demanded the Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology impose the highest-level disciplinary action of dismissal. (감사원은 A를 뇌물 수수와 청탁금지법 위반 혐의로 검찰에 고발하고, 한국건설기술연구원에는 최고 수위인 해임 징계를 요구했다.)

Meanwhile, a Grade 5 civil servant at the National Data Agency (formerly Statistics Korea) was also found to have received 5 million won from a private company and other work-related individuals in exchange for awarding projects worth 939 million won. The Board of Audit and Inspection demanded the Data Agency demote this official. (한편 국가데이터처(옛 통계청) 5급 공무원도 9억3900만원짜리 일감을 준 민간 업체 등 직무 관련자로부터 500만원을 받은 것으로 드러났다. 감사원은 데이터처에 이 공무원을 강등하라고 요구했다.)

item.title: Joo Jin-woo: "National Election Commission Pushes 17 Billion Won Worth of Contracts to Ex-Officials' Family Companies... 'Election Mafia Cartel'" (주진우 “선관위, 전관 가족회사에 170억원대 일감 몰아줘...‘선피아 카르텔’”)
item.description:
Joo Jin-woo: "National Election Commission Pushes 17 Billion Won Worth of Contracts to Ex-Officials' Family Companies... 'Election Mafia Cartel'" (주진우 “선관위, 전관 가족회사에 170억원대 일감 몰아줘...‘선피아 카르텔’”)

Allegations surfaced on the 17th that the National Election Commission (NEC) funneled approximately 17 billion won worth of contracts to family-run businesses of former employees. (중앙선거관리위원회가 전 직원의 가족회사에 170억원대 일감을 몰아줬다는 의혹이 17일 제기됐다.)

According to data obtained from the NEC and other sources by Representative Joo Jin-woo of the People Power Party, three companies associated with A, a former head of the NEC's political party division, along with their spouse and son, signed a total of 103 contracts with the NEC. Of these, 90 were awarded through negotiated contracts, amounting to a total of 17.5 billion won. (주진우 국민의힘 의원이 선관위 등으로부터 확보한 자료에 따르면, 중앙선관위 정당과장 출신 A씨와 배우자·아들이 관련된 3개 업체는 선관위와 총 103건의 계약을 체결했다. 이 중 90건은 수의계약으로 이뤄졌다. 총 175억원 규모다.)

Company B, where A serves as CEO, had only three employees but secured 66 contracts with the NEC worth a total of 2.9752 billion won. This company also supplied the controversial 'semi-transparent in-district early voting booths' during the June 3 local elections. (A씨가 대표이사로 있는 B사의 경우 직원이 단 3명에 불과했지만, 선관위와 66건, 총 29억7520만 원 규모의 계약을 맺었다. 이 업체는 6·3 지방선거에서 논란이 된 ‘반투명 관내 사전투표함’도 납품했다.)

Company C, whose CEO is A's spouse, signed 9 contracts with the NEC totaling 409.45 million won, of which 8 were negotiated contracts. Companies B and C were located on the same floor of the same building, and A also served as an auditor for Company C. (A 씨의 배우자가 대표이사인 C사는 선관위와 9건, 총 4억945만원 규모의 계약을 체결했다. 이 가운데 8건이 수의계약이었다. B사와 C사는 같은 건물·같은 층에 있었고, A씨는 C사의 감사를 맡기도 했다.)

Additionally, Company D, where A served as an internal director, signed 28 contracts with the NEC totaling 14.16858 billion won, with 18 of these being negotiated contracts. (또 A 씨가 사내이사로 참여한 D사는 선관위와 28건, 총141억6858만원 규모의 계약을 체결했다. 이 중 18건이 수의계약으로 나타났다.)

Representative Joo stated, "This is the reality of the 'Election Mafia (Election Commission + Mafia) cartel,' which even handed out contracts to former officials and their family companies," adding, "Given the risk of evidence tampering, a special counsel investigation should be launched immediately." (주 의원은 “전관과 가족회사에 일감까지 몰아준 ‘선피아(선관위+마피아) 카르텔’의 실체”라며 “증거인멸 우려가 있는 만큼 즉시 특검을 실시해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee on Prescribing Abortion Medication: “Leaving It to Doctor’s Discretion Could Be an Option” (李대통령, 임신중지약물 처방 관련 “의사 재량에 맡기는 것도 방법”)
item.description:
President Lee on Prescribing Abortion Medication: “Leaving It to Doctor’s Discretion Could Be an Option” (李대통령, 임신중지약물 처방 관련 “의사 재량에 맡기는 것도 방법”)

On the 14th, President Lee Jae-myung said he would review allowing the use of “Mifepristone,” a medication for terminating pregnancies, adding, “Wouldn’t leaving it to the doctor’s discretion be one possible approach?” <<> During a Cabinet meeting that day, President Lee pointed out that the use of Mifepristone remains illegal due to a lack of relevant legislation, and stated, “Even if it’s a temporary patch, if it’s better than neglect, shouldn’t we at least apply that patch?” <<> The Constitutional Court ruled the abortion law unconstitutional in 2019, mandating legislative revisions by the end of the following year. However, as the National Assembly has avoided debate over whether to permit abortion and, if so, up to which week of pregnancy, the abortion law remains in a legislative vacuum. Consequently, Mifepristone, which can induce termination in early pregnancy, cannot be prescribed domestically. <<> President Lee remarked, “If we ask up to how many weeks abortion should be allowed, the whole country would erupt in controversy,” and added, “The president could push it through with full resolve, but it doesn’t seem like the kind of issue that warrants that.” <<> President Lee said, “Let’s take a more practical approach,” mentioning options such as selling it in pharmacies or allowing doctors to prescribe it at their discretion. “If selling it in pharmacies is too irresponsible,” he said, “then what about the next step—letting doctors decide at their discretion? Doctors already make judgments about human lives, don’t they?” <<> President Lee added, “We entrust doctors with decisions on life-and-death surgeries. Couldn’t we leave it to them to decide whether prescribing it is appropriate after comprehensively considering respect for life and health?” He continued, “Specifying by law exactly up to how many weeks (abortion is allowed) isn’t absolute; it could vary depending on the pregnant woman’s health condition. The law isn’t necessarily the ultimate truth.” <<> President Lee concluded, “It’s imperfect, but wouldn’t it be better than leaving it unresolved and allowing people to buy it from abroad with no prescription and no oversight? An imperfect solution is better than neglect.” The aim is to prevent problems arising from people ordering Mifepristone from overseas without a doctor’s prescription. (이재명 대통령은 14일 임신 중지 약물인 ‘미프진’ 사용을 허용하는 방안을 검토하라면서 “의사 재량으로 맡기는 것도 하나의 방법 아니겠느냐”고 말했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Says "Coolly Accepting" Preferential Voting System, But "Has Much to Say but Won't" (정청래, 선호투표제 도입에 “쿨하게 수용…할말 많으나 않겠다”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae Says "Coolly Accepting" Preferential Voting System, But "Has Much to Say but Won't" (정청래, 선호투표제 도입에 “쿨하게 수용…할말 많으나 않겠다”)

As the Democratic Party of Korea pushes to amend its party rules to introduce a preferential voting system for electing its party leader at the August 17 national convention, former leader Jung Cheong-rae stated his acceptance of the plan on the 14th. (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회에서 당 대표 선출 방식으로 선호투표제를 도입하기 위해 당규 개정을 추진하자, 정청래 전 대표가 수용 입장을 14일 밝혔다.)

On his Facebook page that day, Jung posted regarding the introduction of the preferential voting system, "I coolly accept the party's decision." He added, "I have much to say, but I won't say it. I will protect the Democratic Party, so now I ask party members to protect Jung Cheong-rae." (정 전 대표는 이날 자신의 페이스북에 선호투표제 도입 관련, “당의 결정을 쿨하게 수용한다”라고 올렸다. 이어 “할 말은 많으나 말하지 않겠다. 제가 민주당을 지킬테니, 이제 당원들께서 정청래를 지켜달라”라고도 했다.)

Earlier that morning, on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel, Jung had said, "(The introduction of the preferential voting system) violates the party constitution and rules. So, what the preparatory committee is currently approving is not valid even if passed. The grounds for violating the party constitution and rules must be eliminated." (앞서 정 전 대표는 이날 오전 김어준씨의 유튜브 채널에 나가서는 “(선호투표제 도입은) 당헌당규 위반이다. 그래서 지금 전준위에서 의결하는 것은 의결은 했으나 의결된 것이 아니다. 당헌당규 위반 소지를 없애야 된다”고 했었다.)

He added, "A runoff voting system could be adopted, or a preferential voting system could be used. (However,) please eliminate the grounds for violating the party constitution and rules. Whatever is decided under those conditions, I will abide by it. That is my position." (그러면서 “결선투표제를 해도 되고 선호투표제를 해도 된다. (다만) 당헌당규 위반 소지를 없애 달라. 그런 상태에서 무엇을 결정하든 저는 따르겠다. 이런 입장”이라고 했다.)

Although the decision was made to introduce a 'Youth Supreme Council Member,' it was rejected in the Supreme Council meeting, leading to differing stances among party leadership candidates, including Jung. The Youth Supreme Council Member system would have set aside one of the five elected Supreme Council seats for a youth representative to be separately elected. (‘청년 최고위원’을 도입하기로 했지만 최고위원회의에서 부결되자, 정 전 대표를 비롯한 당권주자들은 입장차를 보였다. 청년 최고위원은 선출직 최고위원 5명 중 1명을 청년 몫으로 별도 선출하는 제도다.)

Former lawmaker Kim Min-seok said, "This is a time when all efforts to expand the party's connection with the youth are insufficient," and added, "If I become party leader, I will entrust one appointed Supreme Council seat to the youth and have them elected through a festival-style method." (김민석 전 총리는 “당과 청년층 접점을 넓히는 모든 시도를 다 해도 모자랄 때”라며 “당대표가 되면 지명직 최고위원 한 석을 청년층에 맡기고 축제형 선출방식으로 뽑겠다”고 했다.)

He also stated, "I will immediately push for a constitutional amendment to guarantee one elected Supreme Council seat for the youth." (또 “선출직 최고위원 한 석을 청년에게 보장하는 당헌개정도 바로 추진하겠다”고 했다.)

Jung countered, "The Youth Supreme Council Member system has no basis whatsoever in the party constitution and rules. Do you think adopting the Youth Supreme Council Member system will make all those in their 20s and 30s support us or boost approval ratings? I do not agree with that." (정 전 대표는 “청년최고위원제는 당헌당규상 근거가 하나도 없다. 청년최고위원제를 해야 2030들이 다 지지하느냐, 지지율이 높아지느냐 저는 그것에는 동의하지 않는다”고도 했다.)

Lawmaker Song Young-gil said on YTN Radio the previous day, "I think it could be done by amending the (party constitution and rules) at the same time," and added, "Without the youth in their 20s and 30s, there is no presidential election in 2030. With that resolve, I announced a pledge to appoint appointed Supreme Council members from the 2030 generation." (송영길 의원은 전날 YTN라디오에서 “(당헌당규를) 개정하면서 같이 하면 되지 않을까 싶다”며 “청년 2030 없이는 2030년 대선 없다, 이런 각오로 지명직 최고위원을 2030으로 임명하겠다는 공약을 발표했다”고 했다.)

item.title: Real Estate Supervision Task Force "58 Cases of Suspected Illegal Apartment Applications in Dongtan Uncovered… Will Track to the End" (부동산감독추진단 “동탄 아파트 부정 청약 의심 58건 적발… 끝까지 추적”)
item.description:
Real Estate Supervision Task Force "58 Cases of Suspected Illegal Apartment Applications in Dongtan Uncovered… Will Track to the End" (부동산감독추진단 “동탄 아파트 부정 청약 의심 58건 적발… 끝까지 추적”)

The government announced on the 14th that it has identified 58 individuals suspected of illegally applying for apartments in Hwaseong, Gyeonggi Province's Dongtan 2 New Town, and referred 4 of them to the prosecution. It also uncovered a case in Seoul where a person falsely sold an apartment to their own company to inflate housing prices. (정부가 경기 화성 동탄2신도시에서 아파트 청약을 부정하게 한 것으로 의심되는 사람을 58명 적발해 4명을 검찰에 송치했다고 14일 밝혔다. 서울에서 자기가 속한 회사에 아파트를 허위로 팔아 ‘집값 띄우기’를 한 사람도 적발됐다.)

On the afternoon of the same day, the Real Estate Supervision Task Force under the Office for Government Policy Coordination held a 'Real Estate Illegal Activities Response Council' with relevant agencies at the Seoul Government Complex to share the status of investigations and probes into real estate illegalities. The meeting was attended by officials from agencies involved in real estate policy, including the Ministry of Economy and Finance, the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Financial Services Commission, the Ministry of Personnel Management, the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, the National Tax Service, the National Police Agency, the Seoul Metropolitan Government, Gyeonggi Province, the Financial Supervisory Service, and the Korea Real Estate Board. <<> According to the Task Force, Gyeonggi Province identified 58 individuals suspected of illegal apartment applications in the Dongtan 2 New Town area. Their methods included falsifying residency through false address registrations to meet residence requirements, or pretending to support elderly parents to qualify for special supply offerings. Among them, 4 have been referred to the prosecution on charges of violating the Housing Act, with 3 others currently under investigation. <<> Applicant A was caught living with their family in a company dormitory in South Jeolla Province but having registered a false address in Gyeonggi Province to apply for a Dongtan apartment. Applicant B was discovered after moving their elderly mother, who lived separately in Busan, to their own address in Gyeonggi Province to falsely claim they lived together and provided care, thereby winning a special supply slot intended for those supporting elderly parents. <<> The Task Force stated that if these individuals are confirmed to have engaged in illegal applications, they will face criminal penalties of up to 3 years in prison or fines up to 30 million won, along with measures such as contract cancellation, forfeiture of down payments, and restrictions on future application eligibility. <<> The National Police Agency referred C, suspected of price manipulation, to the prosecution on charges of violating the Act on Reporting and Using of Specific Financial Transaction Information. C, an internal director of a corporation, had filed a real estate transaction report in November 2023 stating they sold an apartment in Seoul (purchased for 1.51 billion won) to the corporation for 1.65 billion won. However, the actual transfer of the apartment did not occur, and C canceled the contract with the corporation in August 2024. Subsequently, they sold the apartment to a third party for 1.8 billion won. <<> The police determined that no formal contract was signed between C and their corporation. C had received the down payment and interim payments from the corporation but returned the funds to the corporation within a few days, all while failing to report the contract's cancellation. They then sought actual buyers through a real estate agent. The police concluded that the contract between C and the corporation was a false report aimed at inflating housing prices. <<> Kim Yong-soo, Deputy Prime Minister for Economic Affairs and head of the Task Force, stated, "Illegal activities like fraudulent applications and price manipulation deprive genuine buyers of opportunities to own a home." He urged relevant agencies to "closely cooperate, conduct thorough investigations, track these cases to the end, and respond strictly in accordance with the law and principles." (국무조정실 부동산감독추진단은 이날 오후 정부서울청사에서 관계 기관들과 ‘부동산 불법행위 대응 협의회’를 열고 부동산 불법행위 조사·수사 상황을 공유했다. 회의에는 재정경제부, 법무부, 행정안전부, 국토교통부, 금융위원회, 인사혁신처, 대검찰청, 국세청, 경찰청, 서울시, 경기도, 금융감독원, 한국부동산원 등 부동산 정책 관련 기관 관계자들이 참석했다.)

item.title: 11 Lawmakers from the Ruling Party Propose Bill to Keep Supplementary Investigation Powers, Saying "Disadvantaged Must Be Protected" (與 의원 11명, 보완수사권 완전 폐지 ‘반대’ 법안 발의…“사회적 약자 보호해야”)
item.description:
11 Lawmakers from the Ruling Party Propose Bill to Keep Supplementary Investigation Powers, Saying "Disadvantaged Must Be Protected" (與 의원 11명, 보완수사권 완전 폐지 ‘반대’ 법안 발의…“사회적 약자 보호해야”)

While the Democratic Party of Korea is moving quickly to completely abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, 11 lawmakers, led by party member Hong Ki-won, have proposed a bill to retain some of these powers. (더불어민주당이 검찰의 보완수사권을 전면 폐지하는 데 속도를 내는 가운데, 당내 홍기원 의원을 중심으로 11명의 의원이 보완수사권의 일부를 존치하는 내용의 법안을 발의했다.)

On the 14th, Rep. Hong held a press conference at the National Assembly Communication Center before proposing the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act. The lawmakers who co-signed the amendment included, besides Hong, Ko Min-jung, Kwak Sang-eon, Kim Nam-hee, Mo Kyung-jong, Moon Jin-seok, Min Hong-chul, Park Kyun-taek, Park Hee-seung, Lee So-young, and Joo Cheol-hyun. (14일 홍 의원은 국회 소통관에서 형사소송법 개정안을 발의하기 전 기자회견을 열었다. 개정안 공동발의자에 이름을 올린 의원은 홍 의원 외 고민정·곽상언·김남희·모경종·문진석·민홍철·박균택·박희승·이소영·주철현 의원이었다.)

Rep. Hong stated, "Many lawmakers lacked time for review, which is why not many participated. There were also those who agreed with the bill's content but said they couldn't participate as co-sponsors due to their party positions." He added, "Some said they share the intent but couldn't co-sponsor because it might affect the party convention." (홍 의원은 “여러 의원들께서 검토할 시간이 부족했기 떄문에 많이 참여 못한 측면이 있다. 또 법안 내용에 공감은 하는데 본인이 당직을 맡고 있어서 공동발의에는 참여하기 어렵다고 말한 분도 계셨다”고 했다. 또 “전당대회에 영향 미칠 수도 있기 때문에 뜻은 같이하지만 공동 발의는 못하겠다는 분도 있었다”고 했다.)

Rep. Hong cited cases where exceptional supplementary investigation by the prosecution is necessary, including crimes against socially disadvantaged groups, crimes harming people's livelihoods, urgent cases like detention with tight deadlines, cases requiring consolidation or where victims have filed objections, and minor incidents. (홍 의원은 검찰의 예외적 보완수사가 필요한 경우로 사회적 약자 대상 범죄, 민생 침해 범죄, 구속 사건 등 시한이 촉박한 경우, 사건 병합이 필요하거나 피해자가 이의 신청했을 경우, 내용이 경미한 때를 들었다.)

Meanwhile, later in the day, the Democratic Party will hold a general meeting of lawmakers to continue discussions on the Criminal Procedure Act. After gathering internal opinions, the party plans to proceed through the Legislation and Judiciary Committee subcommittee and general meeting on the 15th. (한편, 이날 오후 민주당은 의원총회를 열고 형사소송법에 대한 논의를 이어간다. 이후 당내 의견을 수렴해 오는 15일 법제사법위원회 소위와 전체회의를 거쳐 처리할 방침이다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "Just One Word on Real Estate"... Han Sung-sook: "I’ll Accept It in Writing" (오세훈 “부동산 한 말씀만”…한성숙 “서면으로 받겠다”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon: "Just One Word on Real Estate"... Han Sung-sook: "I’ll Accept It in Writing" (오세훈 “부동산 한 말씀만”…한성숙 “서면으로 받겠다”)

Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon failed to secure a speaking opportunity at the State Council meeting he attended for the first time after the June 3 local elections. (오세훈 서울시장이 6·3 지방선거 후 처음 참석한 국무회의에서 발언 기회를 얻지 못했다.)

At a State Council meeting held on the 14th to discuss pending issues such as real estate supply policies and tax reforms, Mayor Oh asked Prime Minister Han Sung-sook, "May I say a few words?" and requested to speak on real estate issues. During the meeting, relevant ministries—including the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Financial Services Commission, and the Ministry of Economy and Finance—reported on seven major real estate issues, such as easing housing supply regulations and revising the comprehensive real estate tax and capital gains tax. Right after the report, Mayor Oh Se-hoon attempted to verbally present Seoul City’s policy proposals regarding urban redevelopment projects. (14일 부동산 공급 정책과 세제 개편 등의 현안을 논의하기 위해 열린 국무회의에서 오 시장은 한성숙 국무총리에게 “말씀 좀 드려도 되겠느냐”며 부동산 문제와 관련해 발언을 신청했다. 이날 국무회의에서는 국토교통부, 금융위원회, 재정경제부 등 관계 부처가 주택 공급 규제 완화와 종부세·양도세 개편 등 부동산 7대 쟁점을 보고했는데, 보고 직후 오세훈 서울시장이 도심 정비 사업에 대한 서울시의 정책 제안을 구두로 발표하려 한 것이다.)

Prime Minister Han, referencing the inter-ministerial public debate schedule set to begin on the 14th, stated, "Since there is a public debate scheduled for this matter, it would be better to refer it there for discussion," and firmly added, "Instead of an oral statement, I will accept whatever the mayor wishes to provide in written form. I will process this part as originally drafted." This was effectively a move to block Seoul City from offering verbal opinions. (한 총리는 14일부터 예정된 부처별 국민 대토론회 일정을 언급하며 “이 건은 대토론회가 있으니 그쪽으로 넘겨 논의하는 것이 좋겠다”며 “시장님이 주실 것은 구두 발언 대신 서류로 받도록 하겠다. 이 부분은 원안대로 접수하겠다”고 못 박았다. 서울시의 구두 의견 개진을 사실상 차단한 조치였다.)

Unable to secure a speaking opportunity, Mayor Oh expressed his regret. He immediately turned on his microphone and began, "Prime Minister, I have already submitted Seoul City’s prepared report earlier to the head of the policy office and the deputy prime minister," and added, "Since it seems I won’t be given a chance to speak today, I will substitute it with the content of the report." This appeared to be a pointed remark about Seoul City being sidelined during the meeting. (이에 발언 기회를 얻지 못한 오 시장은 아쉬움을 표시했다. 오 시장은 곧바로 마이크를 켜고 “총리님, 방금 전에 서울시가 준비한 보고서를 정책실장님하고 부총리님께 미리 전달해 드렸다”고 운을 뗀 뒤, “오늘 저에게 발언 기회를 안 주실 것 같으니, 보고서 내용으로 대체하겠다”고 했다. 서울시가 회의에서 패싱당하고 있는 상황을 꼬집은 것으로 보인다.)

Mayor Oh’s remarks caused the atmosphere in the meeting to turn heavy. After a brief pause to steady the mood, President Lee said, "If you are going to submit a report, please include a detailed status report on how reconstruction and redevelopment are currently proceeding in Seoul." President Lee added, "People both inside and outside the city commonly point out that Seoul’s supply volume is severely lacking. So, add to the report a detailed analysis of the specific causes and current status of why supply is being delayed and failing." In response, Mayor Oh said, "That content is already included in the report." (오 시장의 발언에 회의장 분위기는 무거워졌다. 잠시 분위기를 고른 이 대통령은 “보고서를 내실 거라면, 현재 서울시 재건축과 재개발이 어떻게 진행되고 있는지 구체적인 현황 보고도 함께 넣어달라”고 했다. 이어 이 대통령은 “시장 안팎에서 일반적으로 서울시 공급 물량이 많이 부족하다고 지적하는데, 왜 그렇게 공급이 지연되고 안 되는지에 대한 구체적인 원인과 현황 보고도 보고서에 추가해서 제출하라”고 덧붙였다. 그러자 오 시장은 “(해당 내용이) 보고서에 들어가 있다”고 했다.)
